premises.text: Plastic gift cards are lost, stolen, or forgotten, leaving ~$20B unspent yearly—bad for consumers and retailers
premises.evidence_span: there's $20 billion in unspent gift cards every year? And that's because your gift cards end up lost, stolen, or forgotten

premises.text: Mobile app stores gift cards in the cloud with merchant/code upload, balance verify, barcode/numeric redemption and scratch reveal
premises.evidence_span: My cards are now securely backed up in the cloud, and no more forgetting them at home

premises.text: Social send via Facebook/email/text with personalization engine, birthday notifies, phone-agnostic receive, and regifting
premises.evidence_span: Gift is seamlessly integrated with Facebook for convenience around sending gift cards to friends and family

premises.text: Open APIs will let retailers push cards into wallets; launch with 200+ national retail partners as mobile gift-card store
premises.evidence_span: we're going to be enabling both retailers and developers to leverage our open APIs and build on top of our platform

value.text: Fun, social digital gift cards managed from your phone so cards get used instead of lost
value.evidence_span: We're making gift cards fun, and we're making gift cards social

causal_links.evidence_span: gift is here to change all that
manage all your gift card needs right from your mobile phone
you can regift unwanted cards to your friends
making us the largest mobile gift card store

notes: Lost/stolen/forgotten unspent cards as problem. Wallet upload/balance/redeem/scratch folded as one store-redeem mechanism (§4.1.7). Social send/personalization/regift as distinct social module. Retailer API + partner store as platform GTM. Funding/giveaway traction excluded (§4.2). Four domains.
